items.title: Register the Quantum plan as the story source of truth
items.context: Use the Quantum execution plan as the controlling requirement and preserve its non-goals around quantum theory, hardware, wet experiments, solver improvement, and broad scientific correctness.
items.userSees: Terminal/doc output includes: "Quantum claim-admissibility runtime status: M0-M1 implemented; M2-M5 pending."

happy.desc: The story references the Quantum execution plan and records that this implementation slice is M0-M1 only.

edge.desc: Runtime implementation status stays explicit so later hosts do not treat M2-M5 as delivered.

adversarial.desc: No wording claims quantum theory validation, physical validation, quantum hardware validation, solver improvement, production completion, or broad scientific correctness.

items.title: Implement Quantum claim and evidence schema primitives
items.context: Add a bounded runtime schema for quantum claims and evidence receipts with core identity fields and conditional identity requirements from the plan.
items.userSees: Smoke output includes: "valid Q5 energy evidence: PASS" and malformed receipts report stable reason codes.

happy.desc: A valid quantum evidence receipt with required core fields and applicable conditional identities validates successfully.

edge.desc: Deterministic tasks that do not require randomSeed or timeStepHash are not over-blocked.

adversarial.desc: Receipts missing core fields, using unknown claim IDs, or omitting applicable conditional identities are rejected with reason codes.

items.title: Implement deterministic stale/missing/mismatched binding checks
items.context: Quantum evidence must fail closed when Hamiltonian, grid, verifier script, solver config, or output identity does not match the active claim state.
items.userSees: Smoke output includes: "mismatched hamiltonianHash: BLOCK", "mismatched gridHash: BLOCK", and "mismatched verifierScriptHash: BLOCK".

happy.desc: Matching active claim state and evidence bindings return allowed/admissible status.

edge.desc: Optional conditional fields are required only when the claim type needs them.

adversarial.desc: Hamiltonian/grid/verifierScriptHash mismatch, unbound solver output, and unbound plot/table evidence are rejected deterministically.

items.title: Add focused smoke coverage for the M0-M1 Quantum slice
items.context: Create a local smoke task and package script covering valid, missing, stale, mismatched, and weak-evidence scoped-claim cases.
items.userSees: Command output ends with: "quantum claim-admissibility smoke passed".

happy.desc: The smoke passes for a valid Hamiltonian-bound energy claim and a valid figure provenance claim.

edge.desc: Single-run energy evidence remains scoped and cannot prove a stronger ground-state claim.

adversarial.desc: The smoke demonstrates rejection for unbound solver output, unbound plot/table, and Hamiltonian/grid/verifierScriptHash mismatch.
